source_ambiguities.source_pointer: official site identity versus openapi.yaml info.version
source_ambiguities.description: The official site identifies APAAI Protocol v1.0 / RFC-2025-001 while the pinned machine artifact declares API version 0.1.0.
source_ambiguities.deterministic_treatment: Preserve both as separate provenance dimensions; do not equate or normalize one into the other.

source_ambiguities.source_pointer: official site Three primitives versus openapi.yaml Decision schema
source_ambiguities.description: The site presents Action, Policy, and Evidence as three primitives while the machine schema also defines Decision.
source_ambiguities.deterministic_treatment: Treat Decision as a source-defined response record and never as a Guard disposition or authority primitive.

source_ambiguities.source_pointer: POST /actions prose and examples versus components.schemas.Decision.status
source_ambiguities.description: Endpoint prose/examples use approved or rejected while the machine enum is allowed, requires_approval, or recorded.
source_ambiguities.deterministic_treatment: The pinned machine enum is normative for controlled fixtures; prose-only status values are rejected.

source_ambiguities.description: The response example uses direct actionType/requiresApproval/checks/evidence fields while the Policy schema requires rules with when and mode.
source_ambiguities.deterministic_treatment: The controlled fixture follows components.schemas.Policy and rejects the incompatible example shape.

source_ambiguities.source_pointer: POST /evidence examples versus Evidence.checks item schema
source_ambiguities.description: Examples add metadata or error to evidence checks while the schema disallows additional properties and permits only name, pass, approver, and note.
source_ambiguities.deterministic_treatment: The controlled fixture accepts only the pinned check-item schema fields.

source_ambiguities.description: The response-level verified flag means all APAAI evidence checks passed but does not establish source separation or independent verification.
source_ambiguities.deterministic_treatment: Map it only as an external observation and apply the producer-claim boundary.

source_ambiguities.source_pointer: official scope statement versus API governance and approval language
source_ambiguities.description: The site says governance is intentionally out of scope while API descriptions use governance, enforcement, approval, and execution-adjacent wording.
source_ambiguities.deterministic_treatment: Preserve source wording as external facts; none confers Guard execution, approval, legal, certification, or authority semantics.

explicit_non_authority: source identity is not Guard endorsement
source vocabulary is not Guard authority
Policy mode enforce is not Guard enforcement
Decision status is not Guard disposition
Evidence pass or verified is not independent verification
signing or hashing is not truth or correctness
approver presence is not applicable approval
protocol conformance is not legal compliance or certification
